text:
lee: FYI hitting weird SSE behavior across SDKs when clients reconnect: chunks get split, ordering flips, and some clients time out mid-event.
abhijit: Can you paste a raw capture? Also which SDKs are affected (py/go/js)?
sophie: We saw related parity issues: python's sseclient buffers differently than the JS readable stream which leads to different reconnection behavior. Sample app repro would help.
lee: Raw TCP dump from mobile client (simplified):
```
data: {"seq":10,"text":"PartA"}

data: {"seq":11,"text":"Par

" 
/data: {"seq":11,"text":"tB"}

:keepalive
```
Note the `Par

` break causes an extra boundary then `/data:` on reconnect.
tom: That leading `/` smells like a partial write + proxy TCP keepalive interfering. Also proxies sometimes inject `:keepalive` comments.
abhijit: Proposed fixes: 1) server include a top-level SSE `id:` header using monotonic sequence (not just seq in JSON), 2) SDKs should be resilient to malformed leading chars (strip leading non-letters before tokens), 3) add small reassembly window on reconnect to merge trailing partial buffer.
sophie: For parity: JS SDK already exposes a stream reader with on('chunk') semantics. Python SDK uses generator semantics and can lose partial frames. We need identical guarantees: delivered_in_order, duplicates_dropped, eventual_done_event.
lee: I built a tiny repro app: https://github.com/redwood/inference-examples/tree/sse-repro (branch sse-repro). Steps: run server (make local-stream), curl --raw to get stream, kill after 2s, reconnect; compare assembled text. Works reproducibly.
ci-bot: test-run(sse-repro): 3/3 smoke tests passed, 1 flaky test in integration (timeout). See logs: https://ci.internal/runs/2291
tom: For timeouts: mobile libs close idle reads after ~60s. Server-side keepalive every 20s solves most. Also clients should set read timeout >> expected inactivity.
abhijit: SDK change plan: add a small state machine parser across SDKs (JS/Py/Go): buffer until double newline; when reconnect, resume from last-good-id header (uses Last-Event-ID SSE header) and ask server for delta if available. Also maintain seq map per connection to drop duplicates.
sophie: Make sure auth/retry interplay is defined: when reconnecting we must attach the same auth token and an idempotency/session token so server can resume safely. Add header X-Stream-Session.
lee: Edge case: proxies that coalesce writes can join two events without a blank line if the server flushes improperly. Parser must be tolerant to missing blank line but cannot be too greedy (avoid merging two distinct events). Proposed heuristic: treat lines starting with `data:` or `event:` or `id:` as new when at start or preceded by newline; otherwise treat as continuation.
tom: I'll add server-side fixes: ensure atomic event writes (single write syscall) and inject `id: <seq>` on each event, plus periodic `:ping` comment every 25s. Ticket INF-1021.
abhijit: SDK tickets: SDK-512 (parse state machine), SDK-513 (session header + resume), SDK-514 (reorder by id + timeout hold of 250ms). Link PRs when ready.
lee: Also noticed auth retries cause duplicate events when server accepts replays. Use session id to dedupe server-side and client-side.
sophie: Tests we need: 1) mid-stream TCP close + reconnect -> assembled text matches golden, 2) packet-split in the middle of JSON string, 3) proxy adds noise (leading slash or comment), 4) slow client that reconnects with missing last-event-id.
deploy-bot: Canaries queued: streaming-fixes -> staging at 1717054500. See https://deploys/internal/streaming-fixes
lee: I'll PR the repro and add a small harness that simulates mobile read timeouts. Will add notes to devex/streaming-playbook.md once we have server+SDK changes.
abhijit: Add a migration note: servers must start publishing `id:` header within 2 releases, SDKs will accept legacy streams but enable strict-reorder by default in next major. Backcompat flag `sse_legacy_mode=true` for one release.
lee: Great. Logging todo: capture last-event-id and session header on reconnect and emit a metric when server responds with gap. That helps catch misses in production.
sophie: I'll coordinate cross-SDK tests. Assigning tasks: @lee repro + harness, @tom server patch INF-1021, @abhijit SDK state machine SDK-512. Will sync tomorrow morning at 10am.
lee: Thanks all :raised_hands:
